info.description: One successful use of an invite code: which code, by whom, when. Written by the redeem endpoint and read back through the invite-code list; this api folder deliberately ships no routes of its own.

inviteCode.description: The code that was redeemed. Kept even after the code is revoked, so a community's history survives revocation.

user.description: The account admitted by this redemption.

redeemedAt.description: When it happened. Written explicitly rather than read off `createdAt`, which records when the row was stored and is free to change meaning.
